questions: 1. Tell me about your family.
2. What did you do last night?
3. Why do people like playing sports?

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to ask you to describe a picture. Then I will ask you two questions about it. You will have 45 seconds for each response.

questions: 1.	Describe the picture.
2.	When was the last time you played a game?
3.	Why do people enjoy playing games together?

questions.title: Đề 20: gia đình chơi game + giúp người già - trồng cây + thư giãn - Part 2

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to ask you to compare two pictures, and I will then ask you two questions about them. You will have 45 seconds for each response.

questions: 1. Tell me what you see in the two pictures.
2. Do you think volunteering is important?
3. What are the benefits of volunteering for the community?

questions.title: Đề 20: gia đình chơi game + giúp người già - trồng cây + thư giãn - Part 3

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to show you a picture and ask you three questions. You will have one minute to think about your answers before you start speaking. You will have two minutes to answer all three questions.

questions: 1.	Tell me about a time when you felt really relaxed.
2.	Do you find it easy to relax? Why or why not?
3.	Why is relaxation important for people?
